name: CyberMythic Foundry VTT System

author: CyberMythic Development Team

extensions.json.description: Defines recommended and unwanted VS Code extensions for this workspace

workspace-settings.json.description: Workspace-specific VS Code settings optimized for Foundry development
workspace-settings.json.purpose: Provides consistent development environment and automates common tasks

setup: Configure user settings to inherit workspace settings

commonIssues.extensionNotFound: Some extensions may require VS Code restart or manual installation from marketplace
